topics: Pilot pricing and Dedicated capacity quotes
transcript:
[00:00] Alex Chen (Redwood AE): Hey everyone, thanks for making time. Quick roll call?
[00:08] Marta Lopez (Zenith - Procurement): Marta here.
[00:10] David Kim (Zenith - Security): David on the call.
[00:12] Rachel Owens (Zenith - Head of ML): Rachel here.
[00:15] Priya Khatri (Redwood SE): Priya here, hi.
[00:18] Alex Chen: Great. Agenda: walk through the MSA redlines you sent, DPA items, SLA asks, and then pricing for the pilot / Dedicated. Is that right Marta?
[00:28] Marta Lopez: Yep, that's it. We also want to confirm onboarding timeline and who will sign off.
[00:33] Alex Chen: Perfect. So first, MSA. I scanned your redlines — most are standard, a few items to call out: indemnity cap, liability carveouts for data processing, and the termination assistance window.
[00:45] Marta Lopez: Right, we asked for a 180 day termination assist and that we keep export of our data for 12 months, is that doable?
[00:52] Priya Khatri: For Hosted yes, we can provide 12 months export. For Dedicated/private deployments we can also do longer retention--it depends on the contract flavor.
[01:03] David Kim: On the DPA side we need clarity on subprocessor list, data residency for PHI-adjacent data, and encryption key control. Do you support customer-managed keys?
[01:12] Priya Khatri: Yes, we support customer KMS in Private deployments and Dedicated through our KMS integrations. For hosted we offer BYOK via KMS in some tiers — we'll share the exact matrix.
[01:23] Rachel Owens: Quick interrupt — on performance: our main concern is latency for interactive triage workflows. We saw references to KV cache and batching in the doc. Can you give a SLO we can bake into the contract?
[01:35] Priya Khatri: Typical p95 generation latency for 512 tokens on our curated models is around 120–180ms on Dedicated with reserved capacity; hosted varies with burst tolerance. We can write a latency SLO for dedicated pools; for hosted we recommend a target window with fallback policies.
[01:50] Alex Chen: Note that SLOs in the MSA are tied to Dedicated commitments. For hosted we usually provide best effort and credits for downtime.
[01:58] Marta Lopez: Our legal wants a credit schedule, like 5% credit for <99.5 and higher for <99.0, something standard.
[02:06] Alex Chen: We can propose a tiered credit schedule — we'll include that in the redlines.
[02:09] David Kim: Back to security: we need SOC 2 type II, ISO27001, pen-test reports, and SIEM integration for audit logs. Also log retention — 90 days is the minimum for us.
[02:19] Priya Khatri: We have SOC 2 and ISO. We can share pen test summary and provide streaming audit logs to customer SIEM in Dedicated/Private. Hosted can ship logs via syslog/forwarder; retention configurable.
[02:32] Omar Malik (Zenith - Cloud Infra): For networking, do you support VPC peering and private link? We can't allow egress over the public net for inference traffic.
[02:40] Priya Khatri: Yes, we support VPC peering/PrivateLink for Private deployments and dedicated VPC options. We'll share the network diagram. There was a note in your DPA about data residency in EU — you're US-based but with EU patients?
[02:54] Rachel Owens: We have cross-border data. Primary region is us-east, but we need EU residency for some cohorts.
[03:00] Alex Chen: We can architect multi-region Dedicated nodes or private deployments in a EU region. We'll include options and delta pricing.
[03:07] Marta Lopez: Pricing — procurement wants a pilot pricing for 3 months, plus an estimated monthly cost for Dedicated capacity.
[03:13] Alex Chen: Understood. For the pilot we typically offer a limited reserved capacity plus overage at usage rates — we'll send a pricing spreadsheet. For Dedicated we'll give a baseline commit and a burst pool option.
[03:24] Rachel Owens: For benchmarks — can the Redwood SE team run our sample payloads? We need to see throughput for our average prompt lengths (approx 350 tokens) and concurrent sessions ~30.
[03:34] Priya Khatri: Yes, we can do a SE-led perf bench. We'll need a representative prompt set and expected concurrency/window. We usually run the bench in a staging cluster or Dedicated pilot environment.
[03:46] David Kim: How do you handle fallbacks if a dedicated pool is full? We need deterministic behavior — either queue, degrade to smaller model, or route to hosted.
[03:55] Priya Khatri: We support configurable routing policies: queue with SLA-aware timeout, automatic fallback to a compatible model, or cross-region routing. We'll document the default and can include required behaviors in the SLO appendix.
[04:08] Marta Lopez: On DPA, we flagged liability around processed PHI — the wording around permitted processing is tight. Any chance of adding a specific PHI clause?
[04:16] Alex Chen: We can add PHI-specific language and tie data handling to the DPA; for Private/Dedicated we can agree to stricter controls. We'll propose language in redlines.
[04:26] Rachel Owens: Also, are you ok with quarterly security reviews and a contact for incident response with SLAs to acknowledge incidents within an hour?
[04:33] David Kim: Yeah, incident response timelines are critical.
[04:36] Priya Khatri: We can include 1-hour acknowledge SLA for severity 1 incidents for enterprise support tiers.
[04:43] Alex Chen: Great. Any vendor due-diligence portal requirements? Some customers require us to upload artifacts to a secure portal.
[04:49] Marta Lopez: We will require the security artifacts uploaded to our vendor portal. Also need references from healthcare customers.
[04:55] Alex Chen: We can provide references and upload docs.
[04:58] Priya Khatri: I'll prepare a package: SOC2, ISO, pen-test summary, network diagram, and KMS integration details.
[05:05] Marta Lopez: On timelines, procurement wants initial legal review by end of next week and board-level approval the week after. Is that feasible?
[05:13] Alex Chen: We can aim for sending redlines and security docs this week; pilot pricing and a Dedicated quote early next week to fit your schedule.
[05:20] Rachel Owens: Ok. One more technical: do you support model quantization configs or do you only offer pre-quantized variants? Our ops team wants lower-cost inference for batch reranking.
[05:29] Priya Khatri: We have quantization profiles we recommend per workload. For Dedicated you can choose quantization profiles — we'll recommend based on perf/cost.
[05:37] Omar Malik: KMS detail — for dedicated can we control key rotation and have HSM-backed keys?
[05:42] Priya Khatri: Yes, HSM integrations supported for Private deployments; Dedicated supports customer-managed keys with rotation policies.
[05:49] Marta Lopez: Liability cap — your redline keeps it at 3x fees; our legal wants 5x or carveouts for breach. Thoughts?
[05:57] Alex Chen: We typically offer a 3x cap and carveouts for willful misconduct or gross negligence. We can discuss specific carveouts in the redlines.
[06:06] David Kim: Data deletion — we need confirmation of secure deletion upon contract termination and proof of deletion.
[06:12] Priya Khatri: We'll include deletion procedures and can provide attestation for Dedicated/Private. For hosted we can provide export + deletion confirmation within the termination window.
[06:22] Alex Chen: To recap, action items: I'll send MSA redlines; Priya will share security artifacts and propose bench windows; we'll produce pilot pricing and Dedicated quote; schedule perf session. Anything else?
[06:34] Marta Lopez: Please include credit schedule and sample SLA appendix.
[06:38] Rachel Owens: And include the benchmark checklist so we can prep data.
[06:42] Alex Chen: Noted. Any final questions?
[06:45] David Kim: Nothing else from security.
[06:47] Omar Malik: Nope.
[06:48] Alex Chen: Great — thanks all. We'll follow up with the docs and proposed meeting times.
[06:54] Marta Lopez: Thanks.
[06:55] Rachel Owens: Thanks everyone.
[06:56] [call ends]
